title: Easy Appletini Cocktail Recipe by Better Sweet Drinks
description: The “appletini” is a delectable vodka-based cocktail that tantalizes your taste buds, leaving you wanting more! With myriad variations, the stunning electric green beverage with a delicious sweet and sour tang is perfect for those with a very sweet tooth as well as those who want a little twist on their tongue!
author: Better Sweet Drinks
instructions:
1. Add apple juice, lemon juice, schnapps and vodka to a shaker with ice.
  2. Shake until cold and strain into a martini glass.
  3. Garnish with an apple slice.
notes: If you don’t want to deal with the hassle of preparing this easy appletini recipe before a party, just pre-batch it. Pour the ingredients into a bottle and refrigerate. Simply mix them in a cocktail shaker and serve.
keywords: easy appletini recipe, easy appletini cocktail recipe, appletini cocktail recipe
